warnings: Public cache has 1 fetch errors from the last update.
ok: Treasury cache covers the 10-year window from 1962-01-02 to 2026-05-18.

suggestions.title: Split dashboard generation into data, analytics, narrative, and report modules
suggestions.detail: generate_daily_dashboard.js now owns cache IO, calculations, narrative scoring, action rules, and Markdown rendering. That makes monthly changes riskier than necessary.

suggestions.title: Create one feed registry for required sources and dataGaps
suggestions.detail: Missing-source strings are currently assembled in several places. A registry would prevent contradictions such as a feed appearing in cross-asset signals while still being listed as missing.

suggestions.title: Separate external marketReaction from rule-based narrative scoring
suggestions.detail: The code already keeps these conceptually separate, but the function signatures pass marketReaction into scoring without using it consistently. Make that boundary explicit.

suggestions.title: Move report prose templates out of analytics functions
suggestions.detail: Markdown generation embeds several English and Chinese explanations beside calculation logic. A small report renderer would make wording changes less likely to alter analytics.

suggestions.title: Add fixture-based tests for the six fixed narratives and duration index
suggestions.detail: Current verification is mostly post-run validation. A small fixture test would catch score drift before a dashboard file is written.

conflicts.title: Public data cache can say VIX exists while Technical Exhaustion still says MOVE is unavailable
conflicts.detail: This is acceptable as a proxy distinction, but the report wording should stay precise: VIX is not MOVE, and VIX should not silently replace MOVE.

conflicts.title: Auction evidence currently lives in marketReaction rather than a structured auction cache
conflicts.detail: The market narrative can cite auctions, but duration rules still cannot use tail/bid-to-cover mechanically until auction data has a first-class schema.

conflicts.title: FRED-augmented Treasury history and Treasury XML history may overlap
conflicts.detail: The merge prefers FRED for overlapping dates. That is fine for standard DGS series, but it should be documented because Treasury XML remains the freshest controlling source intramonth.

policy: This monthly preflight may validate caches and produce recommendations before dashboard generation, but it must not edit code until the user explicitly confirms.
